**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md) · **Design spec:** `docs/design/khala-chat/RECREATION-SPEC.md` §4, §13.4, §22
**Exclusive write surfaces:**
- **Owned:** `apps/web/src/ui/conversation/ConversationList.tsx` (created by KM-180's split) and its test `ConversationList.test.tsx`; `apps/web/src/ui/khala/list.css`; `apps/web/src/ui/khala/NewChannelPopover.tsx` and its test.
- **Additive only:**
  - `ConversationSummary` in `apps/web/src/ui/conversation/ConversationList.tsx`: new optional fields.
  - `projectJoinedEncryptedRooms` in `apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.ts`: populate those fields.

## Outcome

The list pane matches the design (`reference/screens/fullbleed-1440-dark-thread.png`, left column):
- "Conversations" head with "N unread" and a `+` button
- 34px search
- 44px avatar composites showing the first two other members, or `#`
- bold title and `h:mm` time
- two-line preview prefixed with the sender
- 8px unread dot
- accent active row

The `+` button opens the design's **New channel** popover: name field, then **Create**. It replaces today's create dialog.

## Context and evidence

- Spec §4 is verified against the design JS `khRenderList` (`docs/design/khala-chat/source/Aiur Dashboard.html:4173-4184`) and the CSS at `:416-446,611-620`. The popover is at `:4410,4472-4476,4489-4490,4537`.
- Current list: `apps/web/src/ui/conversation/ConversationLayout.tsx:12-45` at `5db209cc` (moved to `ConversationList.tsx` by KM-180); CSS `ui/conversation/conversation.css:3-9,49-58`.
- Current create: `composition/human/mount.tsx:248,281-284` opens `CreateChannelDialog` (`composition/human/CreateChannelDialog.tsx:6-37`), which wraps `features/create-channel/CreateChannelScreen.tsx:33`.

## Scope

1. Render the list exactly as spec §4.1 and §4.2: DOM, classes and verbatim CSS in `ui/khala/list.css`. Use `Avatar` from `ui/khala/Avatar.tsx` (KM-180).
2. Extend `ConversationSummary` additively:
   ```ts
   members?: readonly Readonly<{ id: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; displayName: string; ownerId?: string }>[]   // non-viewer, member order
   lastSender?: Readonly<{ label: string; isViewer: boolean }>
   ```
   Populate them in `projectJoinedEncryptedRooms` (`matrix-browser.ts:132-150`):
   - `members` comes from `room.getJoinedMembers()` minus the viewer.
   - `kind: 'agent'` when the Matrix user ID matches the C4 username `^@agent-[0-9a-f]{8}-[a-z0-9]{6}:`.
   - `lastSender` comes from `latest.getSender()`: the human first name, or the agent label (the display-name part before ` · `). `isViewer` is true when the sender is the viewer.
3. Preview = `{You|lastSender.label}: {preview}`. Fallbacks: no message → `No messages yet`; unreadable → keep the existing `Message unavailable on this device`.
4. Time: `clockLabel` (KM-180 `format-time.ts`) of `timestamp` when it is today, otherwise `dayLabel`. This replaces the UTC `Sep 28` format at `ConversationLayout.tsx:39`.
5. Head count: `"{Σ unreadCount} unread"`, always shown. Unread rows get `.unread`, which gives the dot and the 700 title. The unread number column (`ConversationLayout.tsx:41`) is removed. The row's `aria-label` gains ", N unread".
6. States (spec §13.4):
   - loading: three skeleton rows
   - error: `.kh-cv-empty` with `role="alert"` and "Conversations are unavailable. Try reloading."
   - empty: "No channels yet."
   - search with no match: "No conversations match."
7. **New channel popover** (§4.3), built on `ui/khala/Popover.tsx`:
   - DOM: `.kh-pop-h` "New channel", then `input.kh-txt` (placeholder "Name (optional)", maxlength 60), then `button.kh-btn.pri` "Create".
   - Use `createCreateChannelController` (`features/create-channel/controller.ts:60`): call `setTitle(name || 'Untitled channel')`, then `submit()`. On success, navigate to the room and toast "Created". On error, show the controller's message under the button as `.kh-hint` in `color: var(--block-ink)`.
   - **Omit** the "or" / one-liner (agent-first creation is [M2], §22).
   - Delete `CreateChannelDialog.tsx` and its usage.

## Non-goals

- Shell, brand row, tokens and primitives: **KM-180**.
- Thread, header, composer and detail: **KM-182/183/184**.
- `.kh-cv.dead` and state-card channels: [M2], omitted.
- C3 harness logos in list avatars: avatars use the generic agent monogram unless `harness` is known. **KM-135** owns participants decoding; do not call the participants API from the list.
- Share-link creation after create: unchanged. It stays reachable in the channel header (**KM-183**).

## Contract and invariants

C4 (contracts.md, quoted):
- Username: `agent-<ownerHash8>-<rand6>`, where `ownerHash8` is the first 8 hex characters of `sha256(ownerId)` and `rand6` is `[a-z0-9]{6}`.
- Display name: `<label> · <ownerFirstName>`, for example `Claude · Kevin`.

Member order is room join order. Avatars show `members.slice(0, 2)`; with no members, the `#` generic avatar. `--h`/`--oh` come from `participantHue` (KM-180).

### Worked example

Input summary:
```ts
{ id: '!r1:khala.local', title: 'Release 0.9 go / no-go', preview: 'Pushing both fixes now.', timestamp: '2026-10-02T17:11:00Z', unreadCount: 3,
  members: [{ id: '@maya:khala.local', kind: 'human', displayName: 'Maya Chen' }, { id: '@agent-1a2b3c4d-x9y8z7:khala.local', kind: 'agent', displayName: 'Sonnet · Kai', ownerId: 'kai' }],
  lastSender: { label: 'Sonnet', isViewer: false } }
```

Output (local time 10:11, today):
```html
<button type="button" class="kh-cv unread" data-kh-convo="!r1:khala.local" aria-label="Release 0.9 go / no-go, Sonnet: Pushing both fixes now., 10:11, 3 unread">
  <span class="kh-cv-av" aria-hidden="true"><span class="kh-av kh-hav" style="--oh:330">MC</span><span class="kh-av" style="--h:210"><span class="kh-ini">SO</span><span class="kh-own" style="--oh:150">KA</span></span></span>
  <span class="kh-cv-t"><span><b>Release 0.9 go / no-go</b><time datetime="2026-10-02T17:11:00Z">10:11</time></span><span class="kh-cv-pv">Sonnet: Pushing both fixes now.</span></span>
</button>
```

### Steps

1. Add the optional fields and populate them in the projection (step 2 of **Scope**). Unit-test the projection.
2. Rewrite `ConversationList` to the §4.1 DOM. Keep the props (`conversations`, `selectedId`, `query`, `onQueryChange`, `onSelect`, `status`, `emptyLabel`, `action`) and the filtering logic; widen the filter to match the preview text too.
3. Put the `action` slot (`+`, `.kh-ib.sm` with the plus icon, tooltip "New channel") inside `.kh-list-head` after the count.
4. Copy §4.2 CSS verbatim into `list.css`.
5. Build `NewChannelPopover` (step 7 of **Scope**) and wire it at `mount.tsx`.
6. Run the tests and compare with `reference/screens/fullbleed-{1440,390}-{dark,light}-{thread,list,pop-new}.png`.

## Test scenarios

- `ui/conversation/ConversationList.test.tsx`:
  1. Two members → two `.kh-av` in `.kh-cv-av`, the second static.
  2. No members → `.kh-gen` containing `#`.
  3. One member → a single avatar (44px via CSS `:only-child`).
  4. `lastSender.isViewer` → preview starts `You: `.
  5. Today's timestamp → `10:11`; yesterday's → `Yesterday`.
  6. `unreadCount: 3` → `.unread` and an `aria-label` ending `, 3 unread`; the head reads `3 unread`.
  7. Search "fixes" matches on the preview.
  8. Each status renders the right empty-state copy, with `role="alert"` on error.
- `ui/khala/NewChannelPopover.test.tsx`:
  1. Empty name → `setTitle('Untitled channel')`.
  2. Enter in the input submits.
  3. Success → `onOpenRoom(roomId)` and toast "Created".
  4. Error → `.kh-hint` message.
  5. There is no "or" row.
- `composition/human/matrix-browser.test.ts`:
  1. An agent C4 user is classified `agent`.
  2. The viewer is excluded.
  3. `lastSender.label` is `Sonnet` for `Sonnet · Kai`.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test`
- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test:browser`
- `pnpm typecheck`

**Done when:** the list pane matches the reference images at 1440 and 390 in both themes, and creating a channel from `+` opens it.

## Risks and stop conditions

- If KM-135 changes `matrix-browser.ts` participants decoding in a way that conflicts, rebase and keep both. Never duplicate participants fetching.
- If `getJoinedMembers` is unavailable on the room type, stop and report. Do not fake members.

## Complexity rationale

2: one component restyle, one small additive projection and one popover.
